page.content:
Editable website pattern Cunningham named from Hawaiian 'wiki wiki.'

How Wiki connects

  • Character: Ward Cunningham — Ward Cunningham invented the wiki and the first WikiWikiWeb.
  • Topic: Wikipedia — The wiki pattern is the editing model Wikipedia scaled to an encyclopedia.

What is Wiki?

A wiki is a site whose pages readers can revise in place. Wikipedia is the largest application of that pattern, running on MediaWiki rather than Cunningham's original software.

Key threads lead to Ward Cunningham and Wikipedia.
